trigger_condition: Point styles use unsupported pointColor/pointRadius/pointOpacity names.
guard_snippet: Use fillColor/circleRadius/fillOpacity; test project styles.
potential_consequence: Groups and outliers lose their intended distinctions.
disposition: Fixed in lab 10; lab 16 radius also corrected.

trigger_condition: H3 cells crossing ±180 are emitted as unsplit polygons.
guard_snippet: Cut small non-polar rings at the antimeridian; preserve feature properties.
potential_consequence: Small cells can draw as world-spanning bands.
disposition: Fixed with tested geometry helper; pole-enclosing rings fail explicitly.

trigger_condition: Book execution is off and these chapters have no saved analytical outputs.
guard_snippet: Save representative results and distinguish live-only views.
potential_consequence: Readable chapters omit their computed results.
disposition: Partly fixed: 16–17 now have saved results; 08–11 remain run-required.

trigger_condition: Execution gate excludes nonsynthetic bundled-data lessons.
guard_snippet: Allowlist bundled labs and copy their data into temporary execution directories.
potential_consequence: Report calculations/rendering regress without detection.
disposition: Fixed for 16–17; deterministic lab 09 execution remains a follow-up.

trigger_condition: PBIX derivative lacks extraction recipe, join keys, scenario definitions and transformation provenance.
guard_snippet: Obtain and document the exact derivation and field dictionary.
potential_consequence: CSV charts reproduce but the derivative and scenario interpretation cannot be independently reconstructed.
disposition: Open evidence requirement; definitions are now visibly marked unverified.

trigger_condition: Only Launch links are provided per notebook.
guard_snippet: Provide Read/Run/Watch/Infographic/Cartoon links and visual-type guidance.
potential_consequence: Existing visual resources are hard to discover.
disposition: Fixed with generated directory and visual preview.

trigger_condition: Most standalone notebooks omit the creator and GeoLibre DOI.
guard_snippet: Include Qiusheng Wu, DOI, license/source and pinned builder version in every downloadable notebook.
potential_consequence: Downloaded lessons lose the site's attribution.
disposition: Fixed in all 18 notebooks.

trigger_condition: Generated links hardcode the production hostname.
guard_snippet: Support a configurable base and same-deployment routing.
potential_consequence: Local builds and forks can open a different deployment/revision.
disposition: Open portability improvement; current production links are intentional and checked.

trigger_condition: Confusion counts are only rendered inside an image.
guard_snippet: Provide the counts as an HTML/plain-text table and improve analytical image alternatives.
potential_consequence: Screen-reader users cannot recover the numerical evidence.
disposition: Partly fixed: accessible confusion table added; richer figure alternatives remain useful.

trigger_condition: Map iframe has no accessible name.
guard_snippet: Set a descriptive iframe title.
potential_consequence: Assistive technology cannot identify the map frame.
disposition: Fixed.

trigger_condition: Independent views are described as a story map or linked-view experience.
guard_snippet: Describe a narrative notebook or implement shared selection/story navigation.
potential_consequence: Learners expect coordinated interactions or an exported story application.
disposition: Fixed labels; coordinated standalone story-map app remains future work.

trigger_condition: Role and anomaly rendering uses ignored style keys.
guard_snippet: Use fillColor, circleRadius and fillOpacity.
potential_consequence: Categorical colors and emphasis disappear.
disposition: Fixed; overlaps adversarial style finding.

trigger_condition: Read-only chapters have empty outputs.
guard_snippet: Preserve results and assert required saved figures/tables.
potential_consequence: Book omits the promised analytical views.
disposition: Partly fixed for 16–17; saved-output presence guards added for 12–17.

trigger_condition: Opening a local build or fork follows production links.
guard_snippet: Make the deployment base configurable.
potential_consequence: Reader leaves the current revision.
disposition: Open; overlaps adversarial portability finding.

trigger_condition: A STAC bbox has six coordinates including elevation.
guard_snippet: Use horizontal_bbox to select horizontal axes and validate bounds.
potential_consequence: Elevation contaminates width/height clustering features.
disposition: Fixed with 2D/3D/date-line regression fixtures.

trigger_condition: Discovery timestamps have UTC offsets while acquisitions are made naive.
guard_snippet: Normalize both dates to UTC before subtraction.
potential_consequence: TypeError stops scene ranking.
disposition: Fixed.

trigger_condition: Earthquake feed has no records.
guard_snippet: Stop with an explicit empty-feed message before constructing columns.
potential_consequence: AttributeError hides the actual empty-data condition.
disposition: Fixed.

trigger_condition: GeoJSON feature has properties:null.
guard_snippet: Use (feature.get('properties') or {}).get(column).
potential_consequence: One empty property object prevents the choropleth.
disposition: Fixed with builder regression test.

trigger_condition: cell_m is NaN or infinity.
guard_snippet: Require a finite positive grid size.
potential_consequence: Invalid geometry reaches JSON export or display.
disposition: Fixed with regression tests.

trigger_condition: Screen reader enters unnamed iframe.
guard_snippet: Give the map frame a descriptive title.
potential_consequence: Map purpose is unavailable.
disposition: Fixed; overlaps adversarial accessibility finding.

trigger_condition: Attempting to reconstruct or interpret PBIX aggregates.
guard_snippet: Record exact transformation, keys, denominators and scenario definitions.
potential_consequence: Derivative provenance cannot be verified.
disposition: Open evidence requirement; overlaps adversarial provenance finding.

trigger_condition: Project message delivery breaks while Python dictionaries still pass tests.
guard_snippet: Test frontend ready/load/update handling, origin/source guards and disposal.
potential_consequence: Maps and elevation scenes can stop displaying data.
evidence: Replacing geolibre:load-project with an invalid name passed the baseline Python camera test; existing browser scripts did not exercise the widget.
disposition: Fixed protocol harness; upstream service and full Pyodide E2E remain separate checks.

trigger_condition: Bundled CSV schema changes outside the synthetic execution gate.
guard_snippet: Execute 16–17 with their CSV and inspect frame/city identities and 3D risk values.

trigger_condition: Committed outputs are missing or stale while new test outputs are discarded.

potential_consequence: Readable Book omits results available after execution.
evidence: Clearing lab 14 outputs still passed baseline schema/guide checks; lab 16 had no outputs.
disposition: Partly fixed: presence and browser checks; full deterministic output freshness hashing remains open.

trigger_condition: MP4 container markers survive a truncated, undecodable video.
guard_snippet: Run real playback, seeking and caption checks in deployment.

disposition: Fixed: all-18 browser media check added to CI.
